title: 第146章 毒杀第145章 相遇
lines: 紫色雷电闪过长空，石林缝隙中，篝火烈烈。
楚生翻转着羊排，不时加上一点调料，看起来极为认真。
“王师弟，你居然还带调料进入秘境，当真有情趣呢！”唐柔盘坐着，玉手撑着白皙的脸颊，眼神中带着欣赏，柔声道：
“这肉可真香啊，还有多久可以吃啊？我馋得快不行了。”
“是啊，王师弟，你手艺的确不错。”吴峰在一旁也称赞道：“我许久没吃过肉食，原以为可以戒掉饮食了，但是在你这烧烤面前，还是忍不住想要吃啊！”
“师兄师姐谬赞了！”楚生忙碌着检查肉排是否熟了，从容道：“马上就可以吃了！”
半盏茶后，楚生开口道：“师兄师姐，好了，随便吃。”
“那我们就不客气了！”二人齐声道，各自拔出一根羊排。
然后，他们拿起羊排的手停在嘴边，却犹豫起来，彼此对视着。
“师兄师姐，你们还等什么？趁热吃啊！再凉了可就不好吃了。”楚生一边催促着，自己也同样捡起身侧的一根羊排，咬了起来。
见到楚生大快朵颐，二人不禁咽了咽口水。
他都吃了，肯定没问题。
如是想着，二人同样大口吃了起来。
七根羊排，二人各三根，楚生只吃了一根。
毕竟对方付了钱，楚生也没办法。
“王师弟，你可还有这肉排，再烤一轮如何，我还吃得不过瘾呢！”吴峰舔了舔排骨上的残肉，意犹未尽道。
唐柔眼睛明亮，显然赞同这个想法。
楚生摇了摇头，无奈道：“没了，之前猎杀这妖兽，我只取了半扇羊排，却没有拿其他的了。”
“那妖兽尸身距离这里才一里，若是二位实在想吃，我倒可以过去看看，尸身是否还在。”
“二位不介意的话，就在此处等等，我去去就回。”
二人对视一眼，连忙道：“无妨，我们和你一同去吧！”
“若是遇到妖兽，也能相互有个照应。”
楚生应道：“如此也好！”
楚生扑灭火堆，然后三人一同离开。
二人跟在楚生身后，眼神相互交流。
楚生刻意将后背留给二人，就是让二人彻底放下心来，勾起其心中欲望。
显然，这种做法的确生效了。
吴峰此刻已经不想再忍耐了。
灰白服饰，青云学院外院弟子罢了，不值得他顾忌太多。
将其杀了，王辰的东西就都是我的了。
一个烤羊排而已，谁不会做似的。
唐柔自然明白吴峰眼神中的杀意，她并没有反对。
一个炼肉境武者，于她而言，并没有太多助力。
吴峰运转气血，右掌微微发红起来。
然后，在吴峰错愕的眼神下，原本攀升的气血，顿时溃散起来。
原本流畅的气血，此刻似乎被阻塞在筋脉中一般。
吴峰此刻不禁紧张起来，面色涨红，额间冒出豆大的汗珠。
身为一个武者，调动不了气血，这是何其可怕的事情。
更何况，现在他还是在雷渊秘境之中。
雷渊秘境可是死亡率极高的地方，天雷随时可能从天而降。
无法调用气血，连天雷他都没法躲避。
而且，进入雷渊秘境无法主动选择离开。
只能等六月之期一到，学院高层动用特殊阵法，才能将本院弟子召回。

Purple thunder and lightning flashed across the sky, and a bonfire burned brightly in the gaps in the stone forest.
Chu Sheng flipped the lamb chops and added a little seasoning from time to time, looking extremely serious.
"Junior Brother Wang, you actually brought condiments into the secret realm, you are really interesting!" Tang Rou sat cross-legged, her fair hands supporting her fair cheeks, her eyes filled with admiration, and she said softly:
"This meat is so delicious. How long until we can eat it? I'm so hungry."
"Yes, Junior Brother Wang, your skills are indeed good." Wu Feng also praised from the side: "I haven't eaten meat for a long time. I thought I could quit eating, but in front of your barbecue, I still can't help but want to eat!"
"Senior brother and sister are so impressed!" Chu Sheng was busy checking whether the steak was cooked, and said calmly: "You can eat it soon!"
After half a cup of tea, Chu Sheng said, "Senior brother and sister, that's it. Eat whatever you want."
"Then we're not welcome!" The two said in unison, each pulling out a mutton chop.
Then, their hands that picked up the mutton chops stopped at their mouths, but they hesitated and looked at each other.
"Brother and sister, what are you waiting for? Eat it while it's hot! It won't taste good if it's cold." Chu Sheng urged, and he also picked up a mutton chop beside him and started to bite it.
Seeing Chu Sheng enjoying the meal, the two couldn't help but swallow their saliva.
He ate them all, so there must be no problem.
With this thought in mind, the two of them started to eat together.
There were seven lamb chops, three for each of them, but Chu Sheng only ate one.
After all, the other party paid, and there was nothing Chu Sheng could do.
"Junior Brother Wang, do you still have this steak? How about grilling it for another round? I can't get enough of it!" Wu Feng licked the remaining meat on the ribs and said, still unfinished.
Tang Rou's eyes were bright and she obviously agreed with this idea.
Chu Sheng shook his head and said helplessly: "No more. When I hunted this monster before, I only took half of the mutton chops, but nothing else."
"The monster's body is only one mile away from here. If you two really want to eat it, I can go over and see if the body is still there."
"If you two don't mind, just wait here and I'll be back soon."
The two looked at each other and said quickly: "It doesn't matter, let's go with you!"
"If we encounter monsters, we can take care of each other."
Chu Sheng responded: "That's fine!"
Chu Sheng put out the fire, and then the three of them left together.
The two followed Chu Sheng, making eye contact with each other.
Chu Sheng deliberately left his back to the two of them, so that they could completely relax and arouse their desires.
Apparently, this approach does work.
Wu Feng no longer wanted to endure it at this moment.
He is dressed in gray and white, and is just a disciple from the outer courtyard of Qingyun College, so he is not worthy of too much concern.
If I kill him, everything Wang Chen owns will be mine.
It’s just a grilled lamb chop, who can’t cook it?
Tang Rou naturally understood the murderous intent in Wu Feng's eyes, and she did not object.
A meat-refining realm warrior didn't have much help for her.
Wu Feng circulated his energy and blood, and his right palm turned slightly red.
Then, under Wu Feng's stunned eyes, the energy and blood that had been rising suddenly collapsed.
The originally smooth qi and blood seemed to be blocked in the tendons at this moment.
Wu Feng couldn't help but become nervous at this moment, his face turned red, and big beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.
As a warrior, it is terrible to be unable to mobilize Qi and blood.
What's more, he is still in the secret realm of Leiyuan.
The secret realm of Leiyuan is a place with extremely high mortality rate, and thunder may fall from the sky at any time.
Unable to mobilize Qi and blood, he couldn't even dodge the thunder from the sky.
Moreover, once you enter the Thunder Abyss Secret Realm, you cannot actively choose to leave.
The only way to recall the disciples of the academy is to wait until the June period arrives and the academy's senior leaders use special formations.
